---
title: Carbon Credit Token
description: Verified emission reduction units with provenance, retirement tracking, and verification body references.
---

## Overview

`CarbonCreditToken` represents verified carbon credits on-chain. Use cases include African forestry REDD+ projects, voluntary carbon market trading, and on-chain retirement with beneficiary attribution.

**Contract:** `CarbonCreditToken.sol`  
**CLI template:** `carbon-credit`  
**SDK method:** `factory.deployCarbonCredit(opts)`

---

## Metadata Schema

```typescript
interface CarbonCreditMetadata {
  creditType:          string;  // REDD+ | VCS | Gold Standard | GS4GG | CDM
  verificationBodyRef: string;  // e.g. "VERRA-001", "GOLDSTANDARD-042"
  vintageYear:         bigint;  // Year credits were generated
  quantityCO2e:        bigint;  // 18 decimals — 1e18 = 1 tCO2e
  projectLocation:     string;  // e.g. "Congo Basin, DRC"
  projectType:         string;  // Forestry | Agriculture | Energy | Waste
  verificationDocHash: string;  // bytes32 — IPFS hash
  lastUpdated:         bigint;
}
```

---

## Deploy

```typescript
const result = await factory.deployCarbonCredit({
  name:        "Congo Basin REDD+ Credits",
  symbol:      "CBREDD",
  assetId:     "REDD-DRC-2025-001",
  countryCode: "CD",
  metadata: {
    creditType:          "REDD+",
    verificationBodyRef: "VERRA-001",
    vintageYear:         BigInt(2025),
    quantityCO2e:        ethers.parseEther("10000"),  // 10,000 tCO2e
    projectLocation:     "Congo Basin, Democratic Republic of Congo",
    projectType:         "Forestry",
    verificationDocHash: ethers.ZeroHash,
    lastUpdated:         BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)),
  },
});
```

---

## Contract-Specific Functions

### Reads

| Function | Returns | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `getMetadata()` | `CarbonCreditMetadata` | Full metadata |
| `creditType()` | `string` | Standard (REDD+, VCS, etc.) |
| `vintageYear()` | `uint256` | Year of credit generation |
| `quantityCO2e()` | `uint256` | Total quantity (18 decimals) |
| `totalRetired()` | `uint256` | Total tCO2e retired so far |
| `totalRetirements()` | `uint256` | Number of retirement events |
| `metadataVersion()` | `uint256` | Metadata update counter |

### Writes (any holder)

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `retire(uint256 amount, string beneficiary, string note)` | Burn credits and record retirement on-chain. Emits `CreditsRetired`. |

---

## Retirement

Retiring credits permanently removes them from circulation and records the beneficiary:

```typescript
const token = adapter.carbonCreditToken(tokenAddress);

await token.retire(
  ethers.parseEther("100"),    // 100 tCO2e
  "Acme Corp — 2025 scope 1", // beneficiary label
  "Annual carbon offset programme"
);
```

---

## Events

```
Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)
MetadataUpdated(uint256 indexed version, uint256 timestamp)
CreditsRetired(
  address indexed retiredBy,
  uint256 amount,
  string beneficiary,
  uint256 retirementIndex,
  uint256 timestamp
)
```
